top_findings.title: No README.md with setup and run instructions in the workspace
top_findings.evidence: run_dir has no README.md (find . -iname '*readme*' -> only TASK.md). The agent DID emit a write_file for a README, but to a corrupted path '/Users/adriancockcroft/.retort/work/retot-local-s0z95uwv/retort-4a92dd9bb8a7/README.md' (note 'retot-local', missing the 'r' in 'retort-local-s0z95uwv' — the real playpen). The 1360-byte README landed in a stray sibling directory and was never archived.
top_findings.suggestion: Agent path-typo bug, not a harness block (all 8 other write_file calls used the correct playpen path and succeeded). R11 genuinely unmet for this run.

second_opinion.root_cause: agent wrote README.md to a corrupted path (retot-local-... instead of retort-local-...), outside the archived playpen; genuine agent error, not a harness block
